semiconductor_relevance: High — Axcelis Technologies specializes in ion implantation equipment, a critical step in the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: Axcelis Technologies is a leading provider of innovative ion implantation systems for semiconductor manufacturing. With over 45 years of experience, the company focuses on delivering high-quality, cost-effective solutions tailored to the unique challenges of various semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Purion product family for ion implantation
